title: Smart India Hackathon 2025 - KITCOEK
text:
SMART INDIA HACKATHON (SIH) 2025 — KITCOEK

KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur (KITCOEK) actively participates in the Smart India Hackathon (SIH), a nationwide initiative by the Government of India to encourage innovation and problem-solving among engineering students.

ABOUT SMART INDIA HACKATHON
Smart India Hackathon (SIH) is a pan-India initiative by the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell (MIC) and AICTE. It is a platform where students solve real-world problems posed by government ministries, departments, industries, and NGOs.

SIH 2025 — KITCOEK PARTICIPATION
- KITCOEK students participate in SIH every year at both internal (institute-level) and national levels.
- The Internal Smart India Hackathon is conducted at KITCOEK to select teams for the national round.
- KITCOEK's Mayura-AICTE Idea Lab and NIDHI i-TBI incubation centre support students in innovation.

INNOVATION INFRASTRUCTURE AT KITCOEK
- Mayura-AICTE Idea Lab: Equipped with tools for prototyping, electronics, 3D printing, and innovation
- NIDHI i-TBI (National Initiative for Developing and Harnessing Innovations — Technology Business Incubator)
- E-Cell (Entrepreneurship Cell): Supports startups and student entrepreneurs
- Apple Training Centre
- Centralized Digital Library and E-Content Development Studio
- Language Labs

PAST ACHIEVEMENTS
KITCOEK teams have won awards and recognition at national-level hackathons and innovation competitions. Students have developed solutions for domains including agriculture, healthcare, education technology, smart cities, and disaster management.

For more information: https://www.kitcoek.in/sih2025
